## Cash Flow Metrics

- **Cash Flow (2012)**: $1,127 million (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities (2012)**: $1,617 million (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Cash Flow (2011)**: $921 million (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Cash Flow (2010)**: $491 million (Source: documents/report.md)

## Calculation

To determine the percentage of net cash from operations retained as cash flow:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Cash Flow (2012)}}{\text{Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities (2012)}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{1,127}{1,617} \right) \times 100 \approx 69.71\% \]
